title: GMUT redundant EFT operator, integration-by-parts, and field-redefinition quotient tribunal
hypothesis: A symbolic structural tribunal can reject a claimed independent GMUT operator basis when redundant operators are not quotiented consistently by integration by parts, equations of motion, and perturbative field redefinitions.
accepts: IBP, EOM, and field-redefinition redundancy labels
rollback: Restore the last typed representative set, retain rejected reductions, and require a model-specific calculation and observation before stronger claims.
boundary: Software and synthetic fixtures can establish only bounded structural behavior. They do not establish empirical GMUT confirmation, THOS effectiveness, production identity assurance, legal or cultural authority, independent reproduction, AGI/ASI, complete accessibility, exhaustive security, or Stage 20 readiness.
